T: Back to school, back to lunch.
D: A rich man-child has to repeat grades one to twelve in six months to inherit his father's hotel empire.
P: Serve the snacks when Billy starts first grade.
S: Grade one ham and cheese pinwheels
Billy's first day back in grade one

Soft tortilla pinwheels rolled with leg ham, cream cheese, cheddar and baby spinach, sliced into rounds and served with cherry tomatoes and pickles. Mix 150g soft cream cheese with 1 tbsp mustard. Spread thinly over 4 large flour tortillas right to the edges. Layer each with 2 slices of leg ham, a handful of baby spinach and 30g grated cheddar. Roll up tightly, wrap in cling film and chill for 30 minutes so they hold their shape. Trim the ends and cut each roll into 6 pinwheels. Serve on a platter with 250g cherry tomatoes and a few cornichons.

Triple-decker toasted club sandwiches with roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise, cut into bite-size squares and pinned with toothpicks. Grill 6 rashers bacon until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread. Spread with 4 tbsp mayonnaise. For each of 4 sandwiches, layer toast, 50g sliced cooked chicken, lettuce and tomato, then toast, bacon and lettuce, then the last toast. Press down gently and pin with 4 toothpicks. Trim the crusts and cut each into 4 squares. Serve with a handful of salted potato crisps on the side.
M: the pool party at the Madison mansion

Grilled frankfurts in toasted buns loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, diced white onion and yellow mustard, with plenty of napkins. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, 200g tomato passata and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes, turning. Toast 8 split hot dog buns. Fill each bun with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar. Grill 2 minutes until melted, then add diced white onion and a squeeze of mustard.
W: Smooth homemade chocolate pudding set in cups, topped with whipped cream, crushed chocolate biscuits and rainbow sprinkles. Whisk 80g caster sugar, 30g cocoa, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt in a saucepan. Slowly whisk in 600ml milk, then stir over medium heat for 6 minutes until it boils and thickens. Take off the heat and stir in 80g chopped milk chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Pour into 4 cups, press cling film on the surface and chill 2 hours. Top with whipped cream from 200ml thickened cream, 4 crushed chocolate biscuits and sprinkles.
K: Back to school chocolate malt shake
Billy going back to school, grades one to twelve

Thick chocolate milkshakes blended with malt and ice cream, topped with whipped cream and a drizzle of chocolate sauce. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Drizzle 2 tbsp chocolate sauce down the inside of each glass. Blend 600ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp cocoa until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and finish with an extra drizzle of chocolate sauce and a sprinkle of malt.
